memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Now fear the Lord and serve him with all faithfulness. Throw away the gods your ancestors worshiped beyond the Euphrates River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord. But if serving the Lord seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord." — Josh 24:14-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
After rehearsing all that God has done, Joshua brings it to a point. Because God has been so faithful, the only fitting response is wholehearted service. "Throw away the gods" — get rid of every rival — and serve the Lord in sincerity and truth.

Then comes one of the most famous challenges in all of Scripture: "Choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve." Joshua will not let the people drift in comfortable indecision. Faith is not something we inherit passively; each generation, each person, must choose. And Joshua leads by example, staking his own household on it: "But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord."

There is bracing honesty here. Joshua does not manipulate or soften the choice. He lays it out plainly and then declares his own settled commitment, whatever others may do.

This decision still stands before every one of us. No one drifts into serving God; we choose Him, and we keep choosing Him, day by day. Jesus said no one can serve two masters (Matt 6:24). The idols may look modern, but the choice is ancient and personal.

What about you and your household? Following Christ is not merely a private feeling but a decision to serve Him with your whole life. Choose Him today — and lead those under your care to do the same.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Have you made a clear, personal choice to serve the Lord?
2. What "gods" might you need to throw away to serve Him wholeheartedly?
3. How can you lead your household toward serving the Lord?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, as for me and my house, we will serve You. Help me throw away every rival and choose You wholeheartedly, today and every day. Amen.
